raw.title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
raw.description:
Founding Engineer


Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices.

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early.

How to apply

Apply with the button on this page.

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

  1. Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions.

  2. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

  3. Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

  4. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

  5. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Compensation: €100.000–120.000 base salary plus 0.75–1% equity

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

Location: Munich or London, or remote within Europe (GMT-1 to GMT+3) with regular meet-ups.

title: Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – IT-Lösungen für Healthcare & Public Sector
description: Neue Kunden gewinnen ist Ihr Geschäft. Zukunftsmärkte gestalten Ihre Chance. Healthcare und Public Sector stehen vor komplexen Digitalisierungsaufgaben. Dafür reicht es nicht, einzelne Softwareprodukte anzubieten: Gefragt sind Beratung, moderne Technologien und Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag funktionieren. Genau hier setzen Sie mit Ihrer Vertriebserfahrung an. Für einen etablierten IT-Dienstleister suchen wir eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Gesundheitswesen und öffentlichen Sektor erschließt. Unser Mandant begleitet seine Kunden über den gesamten Lebenszyklus anspruchsvoller IT-Vorhaben: von Business- und IT-Beratung, Prozessanalyse und Transformation über Cloud, Infrastruktur, DevOps, Cybersecurity und Daten- und KI-Lösungen bis zu SAP, individueller Softwareentwicklung, Integration und IT-Betrieb. Sie gewinnen neue Kunden, entwickeln strategische Partnerschaften und machen gemeinsam mit Consulting- und Delivery-Teams aus komplexen Anforderungen konkrete Digitalisierungsprojekte. Ihre Aufgaben – Vertrieb mit Gestaltungsspielraum Geschäftsentwicklung: Sie identifizieren neue Marktpotenziale, gewinnen Kunden im Gesundheitswesen und öffentlichen Sektor und etablieren langfristige Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf Fachbereichs- und Managementebene. Ganzheitliche Vertriebsverantwortung: Sie steuern den gesamten Vertriebsprozess – von der Identifikation und Qualifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten über Akquise und Angebotserstellung bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Lösungsorientierte Beratung: Sie analysieren die Digitalisierungsanforderungen potenzieller Kunden und entwickeln gemeinsam mit internen Experten passende Angebote aus dem breiten Beratungs- und Technologieportfolio – einschließlich IT-Consulting und Softwarelösungen. Projektentwicklung und Umsetzung: Sie arbeiten eng mit Consulting- und Delivery-Teams zusammen, um Kundenprojekte erfolgreich zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. Netzwerk und Marktpräsenz: Sie bauen Kontakte in Ihren Zielbranchen aus, repräsentieren das Unternehmen gegenüber Kunden sowie auf Fach- und Branchenveranstaltungen und identifizieren neue Geschäftschancen. Strategische Mitgestaltung: Sie bringen Ihre Marktkenntnisse und Vertriebserfahrungen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung der Vertriebsstrategie ein. Sie berichten direkt an die Geschäftsleitung. Ihr Profil – Vertriebserfahrung trifft Branchenverständnis Erfahrung im IT-Vertrieb: Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Direktvertrieb von IT-Dienstleistungen, Consulting oder vergleichbaren beratungsintensiven Lösungen. Branchenkenntnisse: Sie kennen die Anforderungen des Gesundheitswesens und/oder des öffentlichen Sektors. Ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidungsträgern ist von Vorteil. Nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge: Sie haben erfolgreich Neukunden gewonnen und langfristige, tragfähige Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut. Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke: Sie überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten und können komplexe Themen auf Managementebene verständlich präsentieren und erfolgreich verhandeln. Unternehmerisches Denken: Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich, handeln ergebnisorientiert und bringen Eigeninitiative sowie ausgeprägte Abschlussstärke mit. Technologieverständnis: Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und können den geschäftlichen Mehrwert anspruchsvoller IT-Lösungen überzeugend vermitteln. Was Sie erwartet Innovation und KI: Ein technologieorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie aktuelle Entwicklungen im Bereich künstlicher Intelligenz aufgreifen und Innovationen in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitgestalten können. Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklung: Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch interne Entwicklungs- und Qualifizierungsangebote. Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Gleitzeit, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und weitere familienfreundliche Arbeitsmodelle. Urlaub und soziales Engagement: 30 Urlaubstage sowie ein zusätzlicher freier Tag rund um Weihnachten oder Silvester und ein weiterer Tag für ehrenamtliches Engagement. Zusätzliche Leistungen: Monatliche Guthabenleistungen, die für Gutscheine oder als Mobilitätszuschuss genutzt werden können, sowie die Möglichkeit zum Dienstrad-Leasing. Angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld: Kostenlose Getränke und regelmäßige gemeinsame Teamveranstaltungen. Interesse geweckt? Aus Ihrer nächsten Kundenbeziehung könnte ein wegweisendes Digitalisierungsprojekt entstehen. Sie möchten nicht nur Vertriebsziele erreichen, sondern neue Märkte mitgestalten? In dieser Position bringen Sie anspruchsvolle Kundenanforderungen mit erfahrenen IT-Experten zusammen, entwickeln nachhaltige Partnerschaften und sehen, wie aus Ihren Ideen konkrete Projekte werden. Wenn Sie Verantwortung übernehmen und Healthcare sowie Public Sector aktiv voranbringen möchten, sollten wir miteinander sprechen. Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung über unser Bewerbungsportal oder Ihre direkte Kontaktaufnahme mit eAces. Selbstverständlich behandeln wir Ihre Bewerbung vertraulich. title: Senior Sales Engineer - Data & AI Security
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role:  

Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking a Senior Sales Engineer to drive technical leadership in our sales team, focusing on the Securiti AI portfolio. You will partner with a Securiti Sales Specialist and support 3–5 Account Executives and Veeam Solution Engineers as the technical subject matter expert. 

You will guide customers from needs assessment to solution design, delivering hands-on demos and proof-of-concepts to showcase value. Success in this role requires strong technical skills and the ability to build trust with clients. 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Act as the primary technical contact for Securiti AI solutions during the sales cycle
  • Lead technical discussions and deliver customized security solutions
  • Address customer needs in data discovery, posture management, and compliance
  • Design and present product demonstrations and proof-of-concepts
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer success teams to ensure smooth transitions 

What You’ll Bring: 

  • Significant experience in pre-sales or sales engineering
  • Strong understanding of data and/or cloud security
  • Effective communicator with both technical and business stakeholders
  • 10+ years technical sales experience in security
  • 15+ years in Software/SaaS/Enterprise technical sales
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Knowledge of data privacy/security standards (e.g., GDPR, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001)
  • Experience with DSPM frameworks, Linux, Kubernetes, or cloud data systems
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, or cloud-specific)

description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Who we are

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Staff Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, and you will lead the small sub-teams of two to four engineers that own them.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will build that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a product role with technical ownership. You will set direction for major new capabilities, make the architectural calls that affect the team and the teams next to it, and multiply the output of the engineers around you. You will stay hands-on: most of your week is still building.

What the team owns

  • Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).
  • The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.
  • Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.
  • Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do

  • Architect and drive the delivery of major new features and services for Chainguard Containers, often spanning several engineers or teams, from concept through production and the first weeks of customer use.
  • Make and own the high-leverage trade-offs: which capability to build first, what to defer, when to re-platform and when not to. Write the decision down and bring dissenting engineers along.
  • Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and set the standard for how the team uses them safely as volume grows.
  • Follow a problem wherever it goes: into another team's service, a customer call, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, and work across team boundaries to get ahead of planning cycles.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers through design review and pair work, and set the standard for how the team designs, builds, and ships.
  • Partner with Product and engineering leadership on roadmap, bringing a technical point of view to what we build, not only how.
  • Keep the systems you own healthy: observability, on-call, and the fixes that stop the same page from coming back.
  • Write clearly and often. Design notes, decision records, and status updates are how a remote team moves fast together.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, including leading at least one multi-engineer project end to end, preferably at a startup or a company in hyper-growth.

About Nearform

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. Our Interview Process

  • Technical Lead Assessment (90 mins via Zoom)
    A structured assessment led by a senior Technical Lead or Head of Engineering, designed to evaluate key aspects of a Technical Lead role. This session includes a selection of tasks to cover:

    Architecture Design - We want to see how you approach a high-level problem, demonstrating your design thinking and decision-making process.

    Code Standards and Feedback - We want to see not just your own skills, but also how you improve those around you

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project. 

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

The role

The Group Marketing Controller is the primary finance interface for HelloFresh's global marketing function. The role exists to ensure marketing spend is planned accurately, closed correctly, and reported transparently — bridging the gap between marketing execution and the Group P&L.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

1. Close & Accruals

  • Own the month-end close process for marketing cost lines across all markets
  • Review and validate marketing accruals submitted by local finance teams
  • Identify and resolve booking errors, misclassifications, or missing accruals
  • Maintain clean actuals in the income statement for all marketing line items
  • Work with SE Finance Controlling to improve and create transparency to the markets on marketing IC charges

2. Budget & Forecast Management

  • Consolidate and challenge market-level marketing budgets during planning cycles
  • Lead marketing Guidance creation for Business Plan cycles
  • Maintain the Group marketing budget with actuals vs. budget vs. forecast
  • Flag material variances early and escalate to marketing stakeholders

3. Reporting & Analysis

  • Work with Tech and local markets to improve and automate input quality of weekly reporting
  • Produce monthly marketing performance reports covering spend vs. budget, phasing, and key variance drivers (Leverage A.I. and Databricks Dashboards)
  • Support the CFO/board reporting pack with accurate marketing cost commentary
  • Build and maintain performance reports for Global Marketing teams

4. Business Partnering

  • Act as the day-to-day finance contact for the Global Marketing teams
  • Manage Direct and Indirect spend for the Marketing team

5. Process & Controls

  • Document and improve the end-to-end marketing close process
  • Ensure consistent cost treatment across markets (e.g. working vs. non-working spend, agency fees, media)
  • Identify gaps in how marketing costs are captured and propose fixes

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Clean marketing close every month — no material restatements or late accruals
  • Stakeholders can trust the marketing numbers without re-checking them
  • Variances are explained proactively, not reactively
  • Marketing controller processes are standardised across markets

WHAT THE FUTURE LOOKS LIKE

  • Manage marketing spend between markets by reviewing ROI, AOR and agreed upon KPI performance
  • Centralised and automated marketing controlling at month-end

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • Not a marketing strategist — not expected to have opinions on campaign effectiveness or brand direction
  • Not a data analyst — analytical support comes from the Finance Systems team; this role translates outputs into financial conclusions
  • Not a local market controller — this role holds the Group view; local controllers own their market execution

What you’ll bring

  • Several years of experience in financial controlling, FP&A, or a similar finance business-partnering role, ideally with exposure to marketing or performance-marketing cost structures
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort working with large datasets and BI/reporting tools
  • Ability to explain financial variances clearly to non-finance stakeholders
  • Experience running or supporting a month-end close process
  • Comfort operating across multiple markets and currencies in a fast-paced, matrixed organisation
  • Curiosity about how AI and automation can modernise financial reporting

  • Project Examples
    In this role, you may lead projects such as:
    • Internal developer platform adoption: Build and evolve platform capabilities that make it easier for engineering teams to create, deploy, operate, and scale services on Kubernetes.
    • Kubernetes-based service onboarding: Define reusable service templates, deployment workflows, configuration patterns, and operational guardrails for teams adopting the platform.
    • Developer workflows and test environments: Build development, CI, and test environments that reflect production Kubernetes behavior — including third-party operators and the custom resources services depend on — sequencing CRD establishment, controller readiness, and dependent workloads so engineers get a working environment rather than a partially reconciled one, across both local and remote clusters.

    • Guide the design of reusable onboarding and deployment patterns for services running on Kubernetes, including workloads, networking, configuration and secrets, identity, storage, observability, progressive delivery, and the custom resources and controllers that services depend on.
    • Make environment bring-up and teardown deterministic — resolving readiness and ordering dependencies between CRDs, controllers, and the workloads that rely on them — so engineers get reproducible environments instead of intermittent failures.
    • Partner with infrastructure, security, and application teams to turn Kubernetes capabilities into simple, well-supported workflows rather than requiring every service team to become a Kubernetes expert.
    • Establish engineering standards, documentation, automation, and feedback loops that improve adoption and reduce the time required to bring a service from development to production.
    • Coach engineers through architectural decisions, incident follow-up, and production operations while maintaining a clear focus on sustainable team delivery.
    • Represent the team with technical and organizational stakeholders, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and use adoption and reliability measures to guide prioritization.

    • Practical Kubernetes experience building or operating production workloads and platform capabilities, including deployments, services, networking, configuration and secrets, observability, resource management, and troubleshooting.
    • Depth in Kubernetes deployment lifecycle: Helm-based deployment and release management, kubeconfig and multi-cluster context handling including deploying into clusters you don't own, and integrating third-party operators and their custom resources (CloudNativePG, cert-manager and similar) into working environments — including the readiness and ordering problems that come with them: waiting on CRD establishment, controller availability, and custom resources reaching their own definition of ready. Experience authoring a controller or operator is useful but not required.
    • Experience designing scalable solutions that improve engineering productivity, test reliability, development environments, or delivery workflows across multiple teams.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills in a remote-first environment.
    • A product mindset with a passion for empowering developers through simple, reliable, and well-documented workflows.
    • Alignment with GitLab values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Get to know Okta
Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Auth0 and Okta Platforms enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box, we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

The Okta Technical Account Management Team

The TAM team empowers Okta customers to deliver secure, scalable, and transformative identity solutions by acting as their trusted identity coach. We drive lasting success through elevated technical maturity, proactively guiding their identity decisions and long-term identity vision. We guide a customer’s strategy for customer identity, workforce identity, and security posture while driving value in Okta’s suite of products and, ultimately, retention at contract renewal.

The Auth0 Technical Account Manager Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical expert to join the TAM team. This role specialises in the Auth0 platform, which is an easy-to-implement, adaptable authentication and authorization platform for Consumer and SaaS applications. Basically, we make your login experience awesome. You will be working with a portfolio of well-known brands on their Auth0 implementations as an identity coach. If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Enterprise Sales Director to lead and scale our go-to-market strategy in Germany. This is a high-impact leadership role with responsibility for shaping strategy, accelerating enterprise revenue, developing a high-performing sales team and strengthening our position as the market leader in cyber resilience.

description:
The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d) VLA Training & Evaluation, who will build the frameworks for fine-tuning and benchmarking robot foundation models on collected robot data. The frameworks are meant to work across different foundation models and for teams with modest data and compute.

Responsibilities

  • Training Workflows: Build reusable, model-agnostic training and evaluation workflows, with experiment tracking, model versioning, and checkpoint management, so that different foundation models can be swapped in without rebuilding the pipeline.
  • Fine-Tuning: Implement fine-tuning of pretrained vision-language-action models on collected robot data, for example with parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA or adapters, or with distillation.
  • Policy Training: Build training loops for action-chunking and transformer-based action models, diffusion policies, and VLM/VLA heads.
  • Benchmarks: Build benchmarks with generalization splits, success metrics, and failure-analysis templates.
  • Transfer Studies: Work with simulation engineers on studies, including metrics and ablations, that test whether improvements in simulation realism improve performance on the real robot.
  • Research Baselines: Turn published methods into working baselines and templates that others can extend.

WongDoody creates human experiences at 24 studios across 4 continents. We believe the future can be molded. And by shaping human experiences through creativity and tech, we work to build a future we believe in. 

For us, this starts with our own culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment where every human can bring their whole self to work. Our clients are brands we believe in, from global big players to local heroes to startups we love. With each of our partners, we embark on a journey of co-creation, pushing the boundaries of what's possible and exploring the space where creativity and tech meet. 

Our team of fun, welcoming, values-driven, and collaborative problem solvers has one focus at the heart of everything we do: human experience. Human experiences are the touchpoints where brands connect with customers. And we transform businesses by creating engaging, inspiring moments using strategy, creativity, data and technology - all backed by the global technological power of Infosys. 

Experience, Tech & AI 

We are a cross-unit and cross-location AI, tech and experience team. With more than 50 developers, AI & Fullstack engineers, UX designers and consultants working directly with other WongDoody teams, we are team players and specialists - oth in frontend and backend. As part of Infosys, we belong to a leading global technology company with access to solutions and extensive know-how in the fields of commerce, marketing automation and AI, among others.  

We are now looking for a Solution Architect who designs scalable cloud and AI platforms on Google Cloud—connecting systems, data, and intelligence into robust, future-ready architectures.

Our local benefits 

  • Flexible working hours and 100% overtime compensation
  • Work where it works for you. At home or in the office, or any mix you like 
  • Working for strong brands and clients we believe in 
  • 30 days vacation per year 
  • Urban Sports Club 
  • Nice people in welcoming teams 

What you can expect

Architecture & Platform Design 

  • Design cloud architectures for digital products, data platforms, and AI-driven solutions on GCP, AWS or Azure
  • Define end-to-end system architecture across data, services, and AI workflows 
  • Ensure scalability, maintainability, and long-term viability of architectural decisions
  • Create architecture documentation and diagrams outlining key decisions and solutions to technical challenges  

Integration & System Landscape 

  • Define interfaces, integration patterns, and system interactions 
  • Assess existing enterprise landscapes and design integration strategies (e.g. SAP, CDP, CMS, DAM) 
  • Connect data sources, AI models, and content systems into a coherent architecture

Scalability, Governance & Collaboration 

  • Define security concepts, operating models, and architectural guardrails 
  • Make informed decisions on compute, storage, messaging, identity, observability, and deployment 
  • Work closely with engineering, security, and business teams to establish a viable target architecture 
  • Balance MVP thinking with long-term platform scalability 
  • Help teams reduce complexity and choose the right technical setup
  • Contribute to RFPs, pitches, and the development of visionary architecture concepts
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, recommend suitable adoption strategies for customer projects and suggest improvements on cost, performance, and maintainability

What we'd love to see

  • Several years of experience in system architecture (cloud, data, APIs)
  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect or in a comparable technical leadership role
  • Strong expertise in GCP and AWS
  • Deep understanding of platform design and modular architectures
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems
  • Solid knowledge of security best practices, data modeling, and system performance optimization
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps tools (CI/CD pipelines, containerization, IaC with Terraform or ARM)
  • Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and effectively
  • Confident in client-facing settings, with the ability to engage and advise senior stakeholders (e.g. CTOs)
  • Experience in Buy vs. Build decisions
  • Very good German and English language levels (C1+)
  • Work permit for Germany and at least one year of work onsite in Germany

Your impact

You’ll be the architectural bridge between creativity and computation, enabling WongDoody’s teams to design and deliver intelligent, modular, and headless experiences that scale. Your architectures will empower brands to connect faster, adapt smarter, and evolve with technology, one API at a time.

We care about your personality and professional skills. We don't care about your gender, age, nationality, or appearance and are open to working with everyone.

Through our website or other sources, you may find job ads published by one of our WongDoody sister companies around the globe with whom we act jointly under the band “WongDoody”. For each job offer, only the entity responsible which has published the ad. Contact persons, required information and applicable terms may differ. You can inform yourself how WongDoody GmbH is processing your personal data provided in the application process here.

title: (Senior) Account Manager - Retail & CPG Vertical
description:
WongDoody creates human experiences! WongDoody schafft menschliche Erfahrungen in 24 Locations auf 4 Kontinenten. Wir glauben, dass die Zukunft gestaltbar ist. Indem wir menschliche Erfahrungen durch Kreativität und Technologie gestalten, arbeiten wir daran, eine Zukunft zu schaffen, an die wir glauben. 

Für uns beginnt dies mit unserer eigenen Kultur. Wir streben danach, ein integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder Mensch sein ganzes Wesen in die Arbeit einbringen kann. Unsere Kund:innen sind Marken, an die wir glauben, von globalen Großunternehmen über lokale Held:innen bis hin zu Start-ups, die wir lieben. Mit jedem unserer Partner:innen begeben wir uns auf eine Reise der Co-Creation, bei der wir die Grenzen des Möglichen ausloten und den Raum erforschen, in dem Kreativität und Technologie aufeinander treffen.  

Unser Team aus gut gelaunten, offenen, werteorientierten und kollaborativen Problemlöser:innen konzentriert sich bei allem, was wir tun auf ein Ziel: menschliche Erfahrungen. Menschliche Erfahrungen sind die Berührungspunkte, an denen Marken mit Kund:innen in Kontakt treten. Wir transformieren Unternehmen, indem wir mit Hilfe von Strategie, Kreativität, Daten und Technologie ansprechende, inspirierende Momente schaffen - unterstützt durch die globale technologische Stärke von Infosys.

Große Marken. Viel Raum für Deine Ideen.

Eine Maus, die die ganze Welt kennt. Ein Supermarkt, der Lebensmittel liebt. Und Kaffee, bei dem jede Woche eine neue Welt dazugehört. Klingelt’s? Genau für solche Marken entwickeln wir Ideen, Kampagnen und digitale Erlebnisse. 

Und unsere Kundenwelt geht noch weiter: von Skincare und Interior bis zu Automotive und Technologie, von B2C bis B2B. Unsere Themen: Social & Influencer Marketing, Campaigning & Content und MarTech Solutions. 

Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die mitdenken, eigene Ideen einbringen und Dinge bewegen wollen. Bei uns findest Du den Raum dafür – und ein Team, das Wissen teilt, sich gegenseitig den Rücken stärkt und gemeinsam mit Dir etwas aufbauen möchte. 

Unsere lokalen Benefits 

  • Fexible Arbeitszeiten durch ein Arbeitszeitkonto mit 100 % Überstundenausgleich
  • Arbeiten, von wo es dir passt – im Homeoffice, in einem unserer Büros (Stuttgart, Berlin, Düsseldorf) oder sogar befristet im EU-Ausland
  • Kostenlose Snacks und Getränke in unseren Büros
  • Ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld mit moderner, technischer Ausstattung – MacBook, dienstliches iPhone sowie alle für deine Arbeit relevanten Tools
  • Weiterbildungsangebote, um stets up-to-date zu bleiben
  • 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Zuschuss beim Urban Sports Club
  • Mitarbeitervorteile & Rabatte über Corporate Benefits
  • Ein inspirierendes Team, mit welchem die Zusammenarbeit für starke Marken Spaß macht

Das erwartet Dich 

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für definierte Accounts und Projekte, baust vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf und wirst zur geschätzten Ansprechperson für Beratung und Weiterentwicklung. 
  • Du verstehst, was Deine Kunden beschäftigt, denkst über das einzelne Briefing hinaus und bringst eigene Empfehlungen und Ideen ins Gespräch. 
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Expert Lösungen rund um Social & Influencer Marketing, Campaigning & Content und MarTech Solutions – passend zu den Zielen und Herausforderungen Deiner Kunden. 
  • Du behältst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung Deiner Accounts im Blick: Du erstellst Angebote, begleitest Budgetabstimmungen und pflegst Planung und Forecast gemeinsam mit Deinem Director. 
  • Du bringst Kund und interne Disziplinen zusammen und hältst die Fäden in der Hand – vom ersten Briefing bis zur Umsetzung. Dabei sorgst Du für klare Ziele, abgestimmte Erwartungen und einen verlässlichen Blick auf Qualität, Timing und Budget. 
  • Du gestaltest Präsentationen und Workshops, vertrittst Empfehlungen überzeugend und sorgst dafür, dass aus Gesprächen klare nächste Schritte entstehen. 
  • Du bringst Dich auch über Deine Accounts hinaus ein: mit neuen Impulsen, geteiltem Wissen und Ideen, die unsere Zusammenarbeit besser machen. Dabei bekommst Du Rückhalt, ehrliches Feedback und Raum für Deine Entwicklung. 

Das bringst Du mit 

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder Kommunikation, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder einen anderen passenden beruflichen Weg sowie mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Account Management. 
  • Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld und Freude daran, Kundenbeziehungen eigenständig zu führen und weiterzuentwickeln. Auch aus dem Projektmanagement bringst Du eine gute Grundlage mit, wenn Du bereits belastbare Beratungs- und kaufmännische Verantwortung übernommen hast. 
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Marken, Märkte und Zielgruppen sowie die Fähigkeit, aus Kundenbedürfnissen konkrete Empfehlungen abzuleiten. 
  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Kampagnen, Social Media, Content oder Influencer Marketing und Interesse daran, Dein Wissen um digitale Plattformen und MarTech Solutions zu erweitern. 
  • Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du kannst Angebote und Budgets einordnen und erkennst, was eine wirtschaftlich gesunde Kundenbeziehung ausmacht. 
  • Eigeninitiative und eine lösungsorientierte Haltung: Du sprichst Herausforderungen früh an, entwickelst Vorschläge und bringst Themen voran. 
  • Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, klare Prioritäten und ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann Du selbst entscheidest und wann Du andere einbindest. 
  • Teamgeist, Offenheit für Feedback und Lust, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam Neues auszuprobieren – auch rund um KI und neue Technologien. 
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, mit denen Du sicher beraten, präsentieren und diskutieren kannst. 

Für uns zählt allein Deine Persönlichkeit und Deine beruflichen Fähigkeiten. Dein Geschlecht, Alter oder Aussehen, Deine Herkunft oder sexuelle Orientierung spielen für uns keine Rolle – wir sind offen für die Zusammenarbeit mit jeder Person.

title: DevOps / DevSecOps Engineer
description:
WongDoody creates human experiences at 24 studios across 4 continents. We believe the future can be molded. And by shaping human experiences through creativity and tech, we work to build a future we believe in.

For us, this starts with our own culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment where every human can bring their whole self to work. Our clients are brands we believe in, from global big players to local heroes to startups we love. With each of our partners, we embark on a journey of co-creation, pushing the boundaries of what's possible and exploring the space where creativity and tech meet.

Our team of fun, welcoming, values-driven, and collaborative problem solvers has one focus at the heart of everything we do: human experience. Human experiences are the touchpoints where brands connect with customers. And we transform businesses by creating engaging, inspiring moments using strategy, creativity, data and technology - all backed by the global technological power of Infosys.

Experience, Tech & AI

We are a cross-unit and cross-location AI, tech and experience team. With more than 50 developers, AI & Fullstack engineers, UX designers and consultants working directly with other WongDoody teams, we are team players and specialists - oth in frontend and backend. As part of Infosys, we belong to a leading global technology company with access to solutions and extensive know-how in the fields of commerce, marketing automation and AI, among others.

We are now looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer who connects platform engineering, security, and automation to build robust, scalable foundations for modern digital and AI-driven systems.

Our local benefits

  • Flexible working hours and 100% overtime compensation
  • Work where it works for you. At home or in the office, or any mix you like
  • Working for strong brands and clients we believe in
  • 30 days vacation per year
  • Company Benefits
  • Urban Sports Club
  • Nice people in welcoming teams

What you can expect

Cloud, Platform & Automation

  • Design and operate scalable cloud infrastructures and platform setups
  • Automate deployments, environments, and operational processes
  • Build reliable foundations for fast, stable, and traceable releases 

Security by Design

  • Integrate security early into development and operations
  • Define and enforce standards across infrastructure, access, secrets, and data flows
  • Identify risks early and implement pragmatic, maintainable solutions 

Reliability, Monitoring & Collaboration

  • Ensure observability, availability, and resilience of systems
  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and product teams
  • Bring structure to complex environments and balance speed with quality

What we'd love to see

  • Several years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Operations
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud architectures
  • Experience with container technologies and automated deployment pipelines
  • Solid understanding of security principles, IAM, secrets management, and distributed systems security
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, incident handling, and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with tools like Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar
  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, or Cloud Run is a plus
  • Exposure to security automation, policy enforcement, or vulnerability scanning
  • Experience with AI/data platforms or production AI systems is a plus
  • Understanding of FinOps and cost-aware infrastructure is beneficial
  • Clear, pragmatic communication of complex technical topics
  • Fluent in German and/or English (C1+)
  • Work permit for Germany and at least one year of work onsite in Germany

You’ll be the backbone of secure and scalable delivery, bridging internal platforms and client projects. By embedding security, automation, and reliability into every layer, you enable teams to ship faster, operate safely, and scale with confidence.

We care about your personality and professional skills. We don't care about your gender, age, nationality or appearance and are open to working with everyone.

Please note: This is a job ad by WongDoody GmbH based in Germany. Through our website or other sources, you may find job ads published by one of our WongDoody sister companies around the globe with whom we act jointly under the band “WongDoody”. For each job offer, only the entity is responsible, which has published the ad. Contact persons, required information and applicable terms may differ. You can inform yourself how WongDoody GmbH is processing your personal data provided in the application process

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.

You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. In this role, you will balance deep customer empathy with product discipline—translating complex operational requirements into repeatable core platform capabilities while establishing clear extension points for Professional Services.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Synthesizes underlying commonalities across clients who describe similar operational needs using different language, preventing costly, redundant engineering effort.

title: Senior Developer Advocate
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

Developers and community matter. Our users and contributors have helped ensure that the Elastic Stack (including Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, and Logstash) is more than just code — they are open source projects that people love to use.
Are you the kind of person who is keen on sharing technology with the world and supporting our global user-base? Your activities as a Senior Developer Advocate with a focus on content creation include:
  • Publish deep-dive videos that connect search, vector databases, and agentic workflows. Or covers observability with logs, metrics, and traces including the OpenTelemetry perspective.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends in search and AI or observability to cover what's new and exciting for our users.
  • Build open-source demos and example applications on GitHub that combine Elasticsearch with developer and AI tools.
  • Contribute to Elasticsearch Labs and our YouTube channel.
The DevRel team's mission is to educate and help our users succeed by being an expert in Elasticsearch and the Search + AI or observability ecosystem.
If you read this far and think: "that's me!" — You probably won't need to read any further, and we should have a conversation. But if you doubt the experience we expect you to have, the following should help clarify.

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Create high-quality technical videos focused on search, AI/ML, observability and Elasticsearch as a platform. This covers foundational concepts, sophisticated use-cases, and research trends.
  • Explore and explain how Elasticsearch integrates with other tools and protocols in the ecosystems (e.g., LLMs, frameworks, OpenTelemetry and Cloud providers).
  • Prototype and publish sample applications showing end-to-end Search + AI or observability use cases.
  • Bring a creative twist to Elastic's content creation to keep existing users engaged and capture new audiences.
  • Provide feedback to product and engineering teams based on your hands-on experience and community interactions.

  • A proven track record of creating highly technical and engaging videos — share your best work with us! This is mandatory in the application.
  • Strong technical background and experience in an engineering role.
  • Empathy for the community to help them solve their issues, provide internal feedback to make Elastic’s products better, and fix problems where possible.
  • Comfortable working with a highly distributed team.
  • Experience working self-driven and self-organizing.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English.

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates If you want to be the person leadership turns to for an honest read of the business, and to see your analysis change real product and commercial decisions, this role is for you. What you'll do Shape commercial decisions Own the SumUp Consumer KPI framework end to end — defining which metrics matter, how they're measured and how they connect customer behaviour to commercial outcomes. Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth. Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets. Drive product decisions Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value. Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact. Help Product Managers size opportunities and judge whether shipped features delivered the outcomes they promised. Influence with data Act as an independent analytical partner to Consumer leadership and to Product, Growth, Finance and Risk — proactively surfacing trends, risks and opportunities rather than waiting for requests. Challenge assumptions, metric definitions and interpretations constructively when the evidence points elsewhere. Build trusted reporting and help teams self-serve routine questions, so your time goes on the problems that matter most. Use AI and LLM-assisted techniques to speed up analysis, customer understanding and insight generation. You'll be great for this role if… You form your own view of why something happened and what the business should do about it — not just report what happened. You've influenced senior stakeholders with data, including changing a decision or overturning a long-held assumption. You understand the economics of a digital consumer product: acquisition, activation, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and unit economics. You're fluent in product analytics — funnel, cohort, segmentation and behavioural analysis. You have strong SQL and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar. You use a visualisation tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI to build reporting that stakeholders actually rely on. You turn ambiguous questions into structured analysis and tell a clear, concise story to technical and non technical audiences alike. You prioritise by business impact and are comfortable managing several stakeholders and workstreams at once. Bonus points if you have: Experience in consumer fintech, banking, payments or financial services Growth or marketing analytics experience, including attribution, CAC and channel performance (e.g. AppsFlyer, Google Analytics) Experience modelling customer lifetime value or unit economics Experience partnering with fraud, abuse or risk teams Depth in experimentation design and the statistics behind it Familiarity with dbt or experience working alongside Analytics Engineers Python or R for advanced analysis Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates

If you want to be the person leadership turns to for an honest read of the business, and to see your analysis change real product and commercial decisions, this role is for you. 

What you'll do 

Shape commercial decisions 

  • Own the SumUp Consumer KPI framework end to end — defining which metrics matter, how they're measured and how they connect customer behaviour to commercial outcomes. 
  • Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth. 
  • Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets. 

Drive product decisions 

  • Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value. 
  • Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact. 
  • Help Product Managers size opportunities and judge whether shipped features delivered the outcomes they promised. 

Influence with data 

  • Act as an independent analytical partner to Consumer leadership and to Product, Growth, Finance and Risk — proactively surfacing trends, risks and opportunities rather than waiting for requests. Challenge assumptions, metric definitions and interpretations constructively when the evidence points elsewhere. 
  • Build trusted reporting and help teams self-serve routine questions, so your time goes on the problems that matter most. 
  • Use AI and LLM-assisted techniques to speed up analysis, customer understanding and insight generation. 

You'll be great for this role if… 

  • You form your own view of why something happened and what the business should do about it — not just report what happened. 
  • You've influenced senior stakeholders with data, including changing a decision or overturning a long-held assumption. 
  • You understand the economics of a digital consumer product: acquisition, activation, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and unit economics. 
  • You're fluent in product analytics — funnel, cohort, segmentation and behavioural analysis. 
  • You have strong SQL and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar. 
  • You use a visualisation tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI to build reporting that stakeholders actually rely on. 
  • You turn ambiguous questions into structured analysis and tell a clear, concise story to technical and non technical audiences alike. 
  • You prioritise by business impact and are comfortable managing several stakeholders and workstreams at once. 

Bonus points if you have: 

  • Experience in consumer fintech, banking, payments or financial services

  • Experience modelling customer lifetime value or unit economics

About the Role As an Associate in Strategic Finance, you'll focus on turning financial and commercial data into clear insight - enabling leadership to deeply understand our business and the drivers of performance. You’ll partner with Data Engineering, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders, and build analytical workflows to support fast and data-driven decision-making. Craft executive-style deliverables, which may include decks, models, written documents or AI-powered apps. Leverage AI tooling as a force multiplier to build and automate reusable analytical workflows that enable your stakeholders to quickly understand performance. Strong analytical thinking: you’re comfortable working with numbers, identifying the underlying patterns and drawing sound conclusions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills: you have the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels. Commercial curiosity: you want to dive into the details to understand how merchant, product, and commercial dynamics affect financial performance. Confidence with data tools: You have strong spreadsheet skills and experience with BI tooling and data platforms, or demonstrate a clear aptitude and willingness to learn. Python and SQL experience is a plus. Exceptional attention to detail: you rigorously validate data, pressure-test assumptions, and transparently communicate analytical limitations. title: Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer – Extreme Environments (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads. Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour. Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction). Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack. Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects. Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval. raw.title: Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer – Extreme Environments (all genders)
raw.description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads.

  • Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour.

  • Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction).

  • Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack.

  • Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects.

  • Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval.

  • Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing.

  • Apply static, fatigue, and creep material property allowable (room and elevated temperature) in the substantiation of the propulsion battery pack and PDU, working to established methodologies such as CMH-17 for composites and MMPDS for metallics, and specify the allowable, material data, and test conditions required from the Materials & Processes and Test teams.

  • Automate and script analysis workflows – model generation, parametric studies, load case sweeps, and post-processing – using Python for Abaqus scripting, and develop closed-form and lower-order analysis methods in Python or MATLAB to size hardware quickly and to verify finite element results.

  • Interface closely with the Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, and Airborne Electronics teams to translate analysis results into design improvements and robust, certifiable hardware.

  • Check and release design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements, providing the stress sign-off for propulsion battery pack and PDU hardware releases.

  • Define modelling standards, assumptions, load cases, and acceptance criteria, and maintain configuration-controlled analysis models and inputs.

  • Support test planning and post-test correlation of FEA models against coupon, component, and full-scale test data.

  • Author and release certification documentation, including analysis reports and means-of-compliance evidence for structural, environmental, and thermal runaway requirements.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural/Computational Mechanics, or a related field; a PhD in a relevant area is beneficial.

  • 5+ years of experience in structural/stress and thermomechanical FEA, preferably in aerospace, automotive, battery systems, or other high-performance engineering environments.

  • Experience taking analytical responsibility for hardware, including checking the work of others and providing stress sign-off or equivalent release approval within a configuration-controlled environment, is desirable.

  • Strong command of nonlinear FEA across material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity, with depth in several of the following: cohesive-zone modeling with traction–separation, composite progressive failure (e.g., Hashin/Puck), metal plasticity and viscoplasticity, hyperelastic and viscoelastic materials, crushable foam plasticity, large-deformation and buckling, and frictional contact with pretension, including fastener bearing and bearing–bypass analysis.

  • Experience with room-temperature and elevated-temperature modeling of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, covering temperature-dependent material behavior.

  • Experience in fatigue and damage-tolerance analysis (S–N/ε–N methods, cumulative damage, random-vibration/PSD fatigue) and in creep and stress-relaxation behavior of adhesives and polymers at elevated temperature.

  • Experience with explicit dynamics and impact/blast-type events (e.g., burst-disk actuation, vent impingement, ejecta and debris containment) is desirable.

  • Proficiency with FEA software, ideally Abaqus; experience with tools such as Ansys (Mechanical/LS-DYNA), MSC/NX Nastran, Altair (HyperMesh/OptiStruct/Radioss), or COMSOL is beneficial.

  • Experience implementing user-defined material models and subroutines in Abaqus (UMAT/VUMAT/UMATHT), including the ability to write and debug Fortran, is desirable.

  • Proficiency in scripting: Python for Abaqus automation and post-processing, and Python or MATLAB for closed-form and lower-order analysis methods used to size hardware and verify finite element results.

  • Proficiency with 3D CAD, ideally SolidWorks or CATIA, is desirable; experience with Siemens NX is beneficial.

  • Experience applying static, fatigue, and creep material property allowables to the substantiation of structural hardware, including familiarity with CMH-17 and MMPDS methodologies or equivalent, and with A-/B-basis statistical allowables.

  • Familiarity with aerospace environmental and structural requirements, in particular DO-160 environmental conditions and CS-23 structural substantiation, is desirable.

  • Working knowledge of propulsion battery thermal runaway means of compliance, including DO-311A and the ANAC–EASA–FAA–TCCA harmonized thermal runaway white paper for propulsion batteries, is beneficial.

  • Familiarity with development assurance and safety processes (e.g., ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and ASTM F3230 for small aircraft) is beneficial.

  • Experience with battery systems or electric propulsion systems is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.

  • Fluent English language skills are essential; German language skills are beneficial.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

title: Working Student Robotics Hardware & Electronics (m/f/d)
description: Batch Robotics is revolutionizing how robots operate in factories — not through rigid programming or teaching by human demonstration, but with smart perception and AI intelligence. We are a team of 4 motivated people with +25 years of experience in industry and robotics. Our mission is to make robots smarter and more flexible, enabling batch-size-1 automation for surface treatment economically. We are now looking for a Working Student / Werkstudent (m/f/d) to get hands-on with our robot systems. You will build, wire, and see hardware run in a real factory, working directly with our engineers and founders in our Munich lab. Tasks Build & Wire: Assemble our robot cells — mount cobots, cameras and sensors, wire control cabinets, crimp cables, solder, and get the system powered up and running. Electronics & Measurement: Read and extend electrical schematics, select components, and debug with multimeter and oscilloscope until the signal is where it should be. Test & Script: Run bring-up and end-of-line tests, document what fails, and write small Python tools to talk to sensors, log data and automate repetitive steps. Prototype & Supply: Design and 3D-print mounts and adapters (we will teach you the CAD work), order components, and keep our lab and hardware stock in shape. Requirements Studies: Enrolled in Electrical Engineering / Elektrotechnik, Mechatronics, Robotics or a related field at a Munich university — and staying enrolled for at least 6 more months. Hands-On by Nature: You build things outside of lectures — Formula Student, rocketry, a makerspace, RC models, a self-built PCB. You have actually held a soldering iron and a multimeter. Electrical Fundamentals: Comfortable with schematics, wiring and basic measurement gear. 24 V industrial wiring, control cabinets or fieldbuses are a plus, not a requirement. Programming Skills: You know your way around Linux and can write a Python script. Driver’s License: Class B — you occasionally pick up components at suppliers and join us for on-site work at customers. Availability & Mindset: ~20 h/week during the semester, ideally in full days, flexible in the breaks, on-site in Munich. Curious, reliable, and not scared by a system that does not work yet. Benefits Real Hardware, Real Factories: You work on the systems we ship to customers, not on a training project — and you can join us on a deployment to see them run on a factory floor. Learn from Experts: Direct mentoring from founders and engineers with +25 years in industry and robotics — short feedback loops, no layers in between. Ownership & Path Forward: Your own topics from day one, a natural route into a Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis, and — if it fits both sides — a permanent role after your studies. Environment & Pay: A modern, central workspace in Munich, a well-equipped lab, an international team (working language English), and €16–18/h depending on experience. Want to shape the future of industrial robotics? Send us your CV — a cover letter is not required. Tell us in two sentences what you have built with your own hands. We reply quickly and the process is short: a 20-minute intro call, then a visit to our lab in Munich so you can see the systems and meet the team.
