  • 7+ years in data engineering or a closely related backend/platform role, with a track record of owning a data platform area end to end

  • Deep SQL and strong Python, including query optimization and performance tuning on a cloud warehouse

  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a modern transformation framework (we use dbt)

  • Experience with event-driven / streaming ingestion and its failure modes: schema drift, duplication, late data, backfills

  • Experience on a cloud platform at the infrastructure level (we're on Azure; AWS/GCP transfers fine)

  • Experience operating data systems in production with a focus on reliability, observability and maintainability

title: DNA Synthesis Platform Engineer
description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems. DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time. You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance. This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems. We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes. What You'll Do Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies. Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups. Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development. Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform. Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability. Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems. Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering. Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization. Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production. Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development. What We're Looking For A strong background in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing experimental setups, prototypes, or laboratory equipment. Strong understanding of chemistry, materials, or process engineering, with the ability to apply these fundamentals to practical engineering challenges. Experience developing and optimizing experimental processes, including systematic troubleshooting and performance characterization. Comfortable working across hardware and experimental science, translating scientific requirements into practical engineering solutions. Experience selecting components, evaluating technical trade-offs, and iterating on prototype designs. Strong experimental skills, including designing experiments, analyzing data, and making decisions based on results. Independent, resourceful, and comfortable working on open-ended technical problems. A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a focus on building, testing, and improving systems rather than purely theoretical development. Experience with DNA or oligonucleotide synthesis, including chemical or enzymatic approaches, is a plus. Experience with solid-phase synthesis, surface chemistry, or chemical process development is a plus. Familiarity with microfluidics, high-throughput dispensing, or array-based technologies is a plus. Experience with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or custom hardware development is a plus. Experience with CAD, electronics, fluidics, or mechanical prototyping is a plus. Experience scaling experimental technologies from proof of concept to production is a plus. Programming and data analysis experience, particularly in Python, is a plus. We work at the intersection of world models, video generation, and robotics, building systems that represent complex environments, reason about objects and dynamics, and translate high-level AI intentions into smooth, efficient, safe, and responsive actions across a variety of robotic embodiments.

You will collaborate closely with ML researchers developing multimodal world models and generative systems, and with hardware teams and partners to ensure robotic platforms, sensing, and system dynamics behave optimally in real-world operation.

What You’ll Do

  • Build the Foundation: Collaborate with our world model team to build state-of-the-art training and simulation platform for robotics.

  • Build the "World": Develop persistent 3D/4D scene representations that maintain temporal consistency.

  • Drive Intelligence: Unlock advanced robotics planning and decision making through our in-house, cutting-edge world models.

  • Sim2Real: Ensure sensing and system dynamics perform reliably in high-stakes, real-world operations, where models think, simulate, and act.

  • Push Boundaries: Partner with top ML researchers to innovate on generative models and physical AGI.

Areas of Interest

We are particularly excited about candidates working on topics such as:

  • World models for embodied systems

  • 3D / 4D generative models

  • Robotics manipulation

  • Embodied AI

  • Multimodal AI

What We’re Looking For

  • Background in robotics, or computer vision

  • Experience with 3D perception, scene representations, or world models

  • Experience working with robotic systems, simulation, or real-world platforms

  • Strong programming skills (Python, C++, or similar)

  • Located in London or willing to relocate to London, UK

Ability to work across machine learning, perception, and robotics

Reka's Mission

Reka's mission is to build useful multimodal artificial intelligence and use it to empower organisations and businesses. We are a globally distributed foundation model startup, headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. Embracing a remote-first approach, our team brings together top talent from around the world. Our founding team, along with many of our team members, has contributed to many of the breakthroughs in AI over the past decade.


Why Reka?

  • An Elite Team: Collaborate with top-tier engineers, researchers, operators from renowned organizations like Google DeepMind and Facebook AI Research (FAIR) and successful startups, driving innovation in cutting-edge AI technology.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: Be part of a rapidly growing industry poised to transform multiple sectors globally, offering the chance to make a significant impact.

  • Mission-Driven Environment: Work alongside a collaborative, mission-focused team dedicated to advancing AI for meaningful applications.

  • Inclusive and Open Culture: Thrive in an open and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives and fosters creativity.

  • Generous Benefits: Enjoy 5 weeks of paid leave to recharge, comprehensive healthcare benefits including vision and dental, and additional perks that support your well-being.

  • Visa Support: We provide visa assistance for UK employees to ensure a smooth transition and support your career with us.

title: Mid/Sr. Product Engineer, Intelligence
description: Who we are Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond. Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it. We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career. If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you. About this role This role sits on our Intelligence team — the group building cross-platform experiences that surface actionable data to customers exactly when and where they're most helpful. We're looking for an engineer who can build that end-to-end. You'll have a frontend focus (strong JavaScript/TypeScript and real front-end craft) while operating as a full-stack product engineer. How we work Engineers at Help Scout own their work end-to-end — from problem definition through production, and from the customer signal that shaped the bet to the dashboard that tells you whether it landed. You're full-stack capable, customer-fluent, and genuinely fast with AI tools. We develop in TypeScript, React , Kotlin, Java, and PHP. We leverage Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Kafka, Flink, RabbitMQ, MySQL, and PostgreSQL — plus vector search and LLM tooling for our AI features. We're heavy users of the AWS ecosystem, Slack, GitHub, and Linear. We use AI tools — Cursor, Claude Code, and a growing set of internal tools — every day. We treat our AI workflow as a product we're shaping together, and we expect you to help shape it. Teams are small and project-based. You might be 3 engineers and a PM on one project, 2 engineers and a designer on the next, or holding more of the product thinking yourself. You're expected to operate well across different compositions and ship end-to-end. What you'll do Ship customer facing features across the full stack, with a focus on smooth user experiences. You’ll design and build intelligence features from zero-to-one from loosely defined specs, collaborating closely with your product, design, and engineering teammates. You should be comfortable making calls, evaluating outcomes, and iterating on your work to make the best experience for customers. Sweat the front-end craft. You care about responsiveness, streaming/loading states, accessibility, and the small details that make an assistive feature feel reliable rather than gimmicky. Stay close to customers. Join customer calls when more context is needed to design the right solution, participate in a support escalation rotation, and watch session recordings on the features you own. Bring that signal back into the work. Own outcomes, not just output. Before a project starts, you and a PM agree on a specific outcome metric the work is trying to move. You instrument it, and after it ships you're watching the dashboard and talking to customers to ensure its impact. Co-author the solution. PMs own strategy and sequencing; you bring the judgment and craft for how solutions actually get built. You'll often shape the product thinking too. The best work happens when engineers, designers, and PMs support each other. Own production readiness from the start. Automation, reliability, monitoring, alerting, and logging are all part of how you ship. The work continues after merge. Use AI tools every day as part of your craft. We expect fluency with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar. If you saw a way to make the team's AI workflow better tomorrow, you'd say so. Help us hire. From time to time, partner with our Talent team to interview future teammates. This is one of the highest-leverage things any engineer here does. About you You're a strong, full-stack-capable engineer. You have substantial JavaScript/TypeScript and React experience and real front-end craft, and you take initiative across the stack and ship end-to-end without waiting for someone to own the other half. You hold a high bar for AI quality. You think in terms of evaluation, verification, and guardrails; you measure whether an AI feature works rather than assuming it does; and you know that more AI-generated code is not the same as more value. You're genuinely fluent with AI coding tools and treat them as part of your craft. You move fast without sacrificing judgment, and you have a point of view on where these tools are heading. You're customer-fluent. You actively seek out customer signal because it's how you stay connected to whether your work is actually solving the problem. You own outcomes. You measure your work, and you're comfortable saying "this didn't move what we hoped, here's what we want to try next," then following through. You take ownership of the full development lifecycle — automation, reliability, resilience, monitoring, alerting, and logging built in from the start. You stay with what you ship until the metric moves and the customer is better off. You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. Help Scout is fully remote and writing is the medium of most decisions. You give and receive direct feedback, and you see code review and pairing as real chances to teach and learn. Nice to have Experience making LLM features production-grade: latency/cost tuning, fallbacks and circuit breakers across providers, moderation/safety, and handling sensitive data responsibly. Design sensibility — comfort partnering closely with designers and elevating the craft of an interface, not just implementing a spec. Experience in customer support, productivity, or other tools where trust and reliability are the product. Company values Happy to Help Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community. Craft over Convention Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight. Progress not Perfection Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better. Own the Outcome Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along. Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here . Benefits And Perks Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents. raw.jobDescription:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

About this role

This role sits on our Intelligence team — the group building cross-platform experiences that surface actionable data to customers exactly when and where they're most helpful.

We're looking for an engineer who can build that end-to-end. You'll have a frontend focus (strong JavaScript/TypeScript and real front-end craft) while operating as a full-stack product engineer.

How we work

Engineers at Help Scout own their work end-to-end — from problem definition through production, and from the customer signal that shaped the bet to the dashboard that tells you whether it landed. You're full-stack capable, customer-fluent, and genuinely fast with AI tools.

  • We develop in TypeScript, React, Kotlin, Java, and PHP.

  • We leverage Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Kafka, Flink, RabbitMQ, MySQL, and PostgreSQL — plus vector search and LLM tooling for our AI features.

  • We're heavy users of the AWS ecosystem, Slack, GitHub, and Linear.

  • We use AI tools — Cursor, Claude Code, and a growing set of internal tools — every day. We treat our AI workflow as a product we're shaping together, and we expect you to help shape it.

  • Teams are small and project-based. You might be 3 engineers and a PM on one project, 2 engineers and a designer on the next, or holding more of the product thinking yourself. You're expected to operate well across different compositions and ship end-to-end.

What you'll do

  • Ship customer facing features across the full stack, with a focus on smooth user experiences. You’ll design and build intelligence features from zero-to-one from loosely defined specs, collaborating closely with your product, design, and engineering teammates. You should be comfortable making calls, evaluating outcomes, and iterating on your work to make the best experience for customers.

  • Sweat the front-end craft. You care about responsiveness, streaming/loading states, accessibility, and the small details that make an assistive feature feel reliable rather than gimmicky.

  • Stay close to customers. Join customer calls when more context is needed to design the right solution, participate in a support escalation rotation, and watch session recordings on the features you own. Bring that signal back into the work.

  • Own outcomes, not just output. Before a project starts, you and a PM agree on a specific outcome metric the work is trying to move. You instrument it, and after it ships you're watching the dashboard and talking to customers to ensure its impact.

  • Co-author the solution. PMs own strategy and sequencing; you bring the judgment and craft for how solutions actually get built. You'll often shape the product thinking too. The best work happens when engineers, designers, and PMs support each other.

  • Own production readiness from the start. Automation, reliability, monitoring, alerting, and logging are all part of how you ship. The work continues after merge.

  • Use AI tools every day as part of your craft. We expect fluency with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar. If you saw a way to make the team's AI workflow better tomorrow, you'd say so.

  • Help us hire. From time to time, partner with our Talent team to interview future teammates. This is one of the highest-leverage things any engineer here does.

About you

  • You're a strong, full-stack-capable engineer. You have substantial JavaScript/TypeScript and React experience and real front-end craft, and you take initiative across the stack and ship end-to-end without waiting for someone to own the other half.

  • You hold a high bar for AI quality. You think in terms of evaluation, verification, and guardrails; you measure whether an AI feature works rather than assuming it does; and you know that more AI-generated code is not the same as more value.

  • You're genuinely fluent with AI coding tools and treat them as part of your craft. You move fast without sacrificing judgment, and you have a point of view on where these tools are heading.

  • You're customer-fluent. You actively seek out customer signal because it's how you stay connected to whether your work is actually solving the problem.

  • You own outcomes. You measure your work, and you're comfortable saying "this didn't move what we hoped, here's what we want to try next," then following through.

  • You take ownership of the full development lifecycle — automation, reliability, resilience, monitoring, alerting, and logging built in from the start. You stay with what you ship until the metric moves and the customer is better off.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. Help Scout is fully remote and writing is the medium of most decisions. You give and receive direct feedback, and you see code review and pairing as real chances to teach and learn.

Nice to have

  • Experience making LLM features production-grade: latency/cost tuning, fallbacks and circuit breakers across providers, moderation/safety, and handling sensitive data responsibly.

  • Design sensibility — comfort partnering closely with designers and elevating the craft of an interface, not just implementing a spec.

  • Experience in customer support, productivity, or other tools where trust and reliability are the product.

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own, maintain, and evolve Playson’s Game Engine domain

  • Work on internal frameworks and libraries used by mathematicians to implement game logic and mathematical packages.

  • Review and validate code written by mathematicians, ensuring quality, correctness, maintainability, and proper usage of internal frameworks.

  • Contribute to the development and support of game engines used to run mathematical logic within our platform.

  • Support integrations with external game studios by helping build wrappers and bridges between third-party game implementations and Playson’s platform.

  • Work with data structures and protocols that connect game logic with frontend and backend systems.

  • Contribute to RTP monitoring processes, including validation of production transaction data against simulation data and expected mathematical behaviour.

  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions to ensure a high engineering standard across the Game Engine domain.

  • Investigate issues related to game logic, mathematical validation, monitoring, and engine behaviour.

  • Participate in minimal on-call responsibilities related to the systems owned by the team, mainly around monitoring, alerts, and domain-specific incidents.

  • Take ownership of a highly specialised area where quality, accuracy, and attention to detail are essential.

Requirements

  • Solid experience with Node.js/TypeScript, or strong expertise in another OOP language such as C++, Java, C#, Go, or Python.

  • Good understanding of software architecture, code quality, testing, debugging, and maintainability.

  • Background in C++ or experience working with legacy C++ systems.

  • Experience with mathematical models, probability-based systems, simulations, random generators, or RTP-related logic.

  • Understanding of regulated markets and compliance requirements in iGaming.

  • Experience with ClickHouse or other analytical/columnar databases.

  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, and production diagnostics.

  • Experience with AI-assisted code review or automated validation tools.

  • Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with Kafka, gRPC, Kubernetes, or AWS.

  • Experience integrating third-party games, external studio products, or wrapper-based solutions.

description: Job Title: Senior Integrations Engineer Location Preference: 100% remote in LATAM with preference in Chile working EST Time Zone Duration: 1-Year Assignment with possibility of extension NTT DATA is a team of more than 139,000 diverse professionals operating in more than 50 countries worldwide. Our sectors of activity include telecommunications, finance, industry, utilities, energy, public administration, and health. Our mission? Offer technological solutions, business, strategy, development, and application maintenance while being a benchmark in consulting. Thanks to the collaboration between teams, the human quality of our people, and the fact that we do not conform to what is established, we always seek innovation that brings us closer to the future. Our essence has led us to the forefront of technology, breaking paradigms and providing solutions that truly respond to each client's needs. Our talent has led us to be one of the top six technology companies in the world. Because #Greattech, needs #GreatPeople, like you NTT Data seeks high-achieving team players who quickly adapt to new challenges and entrepreneurial ventures. We are looking for a Senior Integrations Engineer to work with our global client for a fully remote opportunity in LATAM working EST hours. Position Summary Data integration engineer specialized in designing, developing, and operating enterprise data pipelines on ETL tools; Informatica IDMC (Intelligent Data Management Cloud / IICS) as the primary platform, with strong capabilities in feeding the Databricks Lakehouse. Able to work across cloud-agnostic environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) and to apply AI-assisted development with CLAIRE GPT and CLAIRE Copilot to accelerate the build cycle and reduce time-to-delivery. Key Responsibilities Design and implement ingestion, transformation, and distribution pipelines with CDI and Cloud Mass Ingestion. Build and optimize ingestion and ELT into the Databricks Lakehouse using IDMC for Databricks and Delta Lake patterns. Migrate PowerCenter workloads to IDMC using structured methodology and internal accelerators. Operate and maintain integration infrastructure (Secure Agents, runtimes) on Azure and AWS under SLA standards. Apply CLAIRE GPT/Copilot to optimize the mapping development cycle and reduce delivery time. Requirements Technical Skills: Informatica IDMC · Integration Core Cloud Data Integration (CDI): Mapping Designer, SQL ELT with pushdown optimization (full/source/target), Taskflows, mapping partitioning, Dynamic Mappings, parameterization, file listeners, intelligent structure models (CLAIRE-powered), and performance tuning. Cloud Mass Ingestion (CMI): batch and near-real-time ingestion from heterogeneous sources across its variants: Mass Ingestion Databases (CDC), Files, Applications, and Streaming. Cloud Application Integration (CAI): Process Designer, service connectors, guides, and business processes; API and microservices integration. PowerCenter to IDMC: migration and modernization of on-premises pipelines using structured methodology, CDI-PC, and migration accelerators. Platform operations: administration of Secure Agents and runtime environments (Secure Agent Groups), monitoring, and SLA management. Databricks Integration IDMC for Databricks: ingestion and ELT into the Databricks Lakehouse with CDI and Cloud Mass Ingestion, Delta Lake load patterns, and SQL ELT pushdown to Databricks SQL. Connectivity through the Databricks connector (Partner Connect), Unity Catalog awareness, and parameterized job orchestration. AI-Assisted Development (CLAIRE) CLAIRE GPT / CLAIRE Copilot: assisted generation of mappings, debugging of transformations, and automatic pipeline documentation through natural language within IDMC. Awareness of the new agentic capabilities ( CLAIRE Agents , Fall 2025 release) for headless ingestion and transformation flows. Platform FinOps Understanding of the IPU (Informatica Processing Units) consumption model and per-service cost optimization. Cloud-Agnostic (Complementary) Azure: Azure Data Factory (ADF), Data Lake Storage Gen2, Key Vault, Azure Databricks. AWS: Glue, S3, Step Functions, Redshift, Athena, EventBridge. GCP (desirable): BigQuery, Cloud Composer. IaC & CI/CD for pipelines: Terraform, CloudFormation; GitHub/Bitbucket, Jenkins. Databases & Platforms Advanced SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Databricks SQL). NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB; desirable). Data Warehouse, Data Lake, and Lakehouse architecture patterns. Certifications: Informatica Cloud Data Integration Developer, Professional Certification (ICP) (core to the role). Job Title: Senior Integrations Engineer
Location Preference: 100% remote in LATAM with preference in Chile working EST Time Zone

NTT DATA is a team of more than 139,000 diverse professionals operating in more than 50 countries worldwide. Our sectors of activity include telecommunications, finance, industry, utilities, energy, public administration, and health.

Our mission? Offer technological solutions, business, strategy, development, and application maintenance while being a benchmark in consulting. Thanks to the collaboration between teams, the human quality of our people, and the fact that we do not conform to what is established, we always seek innovation that brings us closer to the future.

Our essence has led us to the forefront of technology, breaking paradigms and providing solutions that truly respond to each client's needs. Our talent has led us to be one of the top six technology companies in the world.

Because #Greattech, needs #GreatPeople, like you

NTT Data seeks high-achieving team players who quickly adapt to new challenges and entrepreneurial ventures. We are looking for a Senior Integrations Engineer to work with our global client for a fully remote opportunity in LATAM working EST hours.

Position Summary

Data integration engineer specialized in designing, developing, and operating enterprise data pipelines on ETL tools; Informatica IDMC (Intelligent Data Management Cloud / IICS) as the primary platform, with strong capabilities in feeding the Databricks Lakehouse. Able to work across cloud-agnostic environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) and to apply AI-assisted development with CLAIRE GPT and CLAIRE Copilot to accelerate the build cycle and reduce time-to-delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement ingestion, transformation, and distribution pipelines with CDI and Cloud Mass Ingestion.
  • Build and optimize ingestion and ELT into the Databricks Lakehouse using IDMC for Databricks and Delta Lake patterns.
  • Migrate PowerCenter workloads to IDMC using structured methodology and internal accelerators.
  • Operate and maintain integration infrastructure (Secure Agents, runtimes) on Azure and AWS under SLA standards.
  • Apply CLAIRE GPT/Copilot to optimize the mapping development cycle and reduce delivery time.

Requirements

Technical Skills:

  • Informatica IDMC · Integration Core

    • Cloud Data Integration (CDI): Mapping Designer, SQL ELT with pushdown optimization (full/source/target), Taskflows, mapping partitioning, Dynamic Mappings, parameterization, file listeners, intelligent structure models (CLAIRE-powered), and performance tuning.
    • Cloud Mass Ingestion (CMI): batch and near-real-time ingestion from heterogeneous sources across its variants: Mass Ingestion Databases (CDC), Files, Applications, and Streaming.
    • Cloud Application Integration (CAI): Process Designer, service connectors, guides, and business processes; API and microservices integration.
    • PowerCenter to IDMC: migration and modernization of on-premises pipelines using structured methodology, CDI-PC, and migration accelerators.
    • Platform operations: administration of Secure Agents and runtime environments (Secure Agent Groups), monitoring, and SLA management.

    Databricks Integration

    • IDMC for Databricks: ingestion and ELT into the Databricks Lakehouse with CDI and Cloud Mass Ingestion, Delta Lake load patterns, and SQL ELT pushdown to Databricks SQL.
    • Connectivity through the Databricks connector (Partner Connect), Unity Catalog awareness, and parameterized job orchestration.

    AI-Assisted Development (CLAIRE)

    • CLAIRE GPT / CLAIRE Copilot: assisted generation of mappings, debugging of transformations, and automatic pipeline documentation through natural language within IDMC.
    • Awareness of the new agentic capabilities (CLAIRE Agents, Fall 2025 release) for headless ingestion and transformation flows.

    Platform FinOps

    • Understanding of the IPU (Informatica Processing Units) consumption model and per-service cost optimization.

    Cloud-Agnostic (Complementary)

    • Azure: Azure Data Factory (ADF), Data Lake Storage Gen2, Key Vault, Azure Databricks.
    • AWS: Glue, S3, Step Functions, Redshift, Athena, EventBridge.
    • GCP (desirable): BigQuery, Cloud Composer.
    • IaC & CI/CD for pipelines: Terraform, CloudFormation; GitHub/Bitbucket, Jenkins.

    Databases & Platforms

    • Advanced SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Databricks SQL).
    • NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB; desirable).
    • Data Warehouse, Data Lake, and Lakehouse architecture patterns.

Certifications:

  • Informatica Cloud Data Integration Developer, Professional Certification (ICP) (core to the role).
  • Informatica Cloud Application Integration Developer, Professional Certification (desirable).
  • Informatica IDMC Foundation / Data Engineering Foundation.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate (desirable).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (complementary).

Why NTT Data?

Drive improvements in reliability, performance, and scalability in production environments handling high interaction volumes Qualifications We Value: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field. 5+ years of experience building scalable backend systems in production environments. Strong experience designing and maintaining robust APIs (REST, gRPC). Solid understanding of distributed systems and real-time communication architectures. Experience integrating with third-party enterprise platforms and APIs. Experience working with CCaaS platforms or contact center systems is a strong plus. Perks & Benefits: We offer Cresta employees a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs Paid parental leave to support you and your family Monthly Health & Wellness allowance Work from home office stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment Lunch reimbursement for in-office employees PTO: 3 weeks in Canada Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases. Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner. Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. title: Director, Global Operations Excellence
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role overview:

The Director, Global Operations Excellence will be responsible for leading Operational Excellence, standardisation, transformation, and continuous improvement across the Sony Interactive Entertainment global supply chain.

Working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, this senior leader will oversee a team of Lean experts and Operational Excellence business standardisation specialists, ensuring SIE Operations continues to improve service quality, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and deliver consistent, high-performing operational practices across all regions.

Reporting into Global Operations, this role will act as a key transformation leader across the Operations division, partnering with Logistics, Warehousing, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, D2C, Customer Service, and regional Operations teams to drive measurable improvements across cost, service, process maturity, and customer experience.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead the global Operations Excellence agenda for SIE, defining and executing a transformation roadmap focused on standardisation, Lean capability, service partner development, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the Operations Lean Kaizen Office, driving Lean transformation activities across operational functions, including Kaizen events, value stream mapping, Gemba practices, waste reduction, cost improvement, and operational performance improvement.
  • Lead the development of global operational standards, ensuring SIE delivers a consistent, high-quality service experience to customers, retailers, commercial partners, and internal stakeholders across all markets.
  • Act as the central point for translating commercial, customer, and business requirements into operational solutions, ensuring requests are clearly assessed, prioritized, and converted into realistic delivery plans.
  • Lead global service partner development, including strategic tender activity, performance improvement, and commercial governance across warehousing 3PLs, control tower 4PLs, transportation partners, and other key Operations service providers.
  • Oversee centralised budgetary analysis across Operations, supporting visibility, control, and governance of OPEX and CAPEX activities across the global supply chain.
  • Generate data-driven insights into operational performance, ways of working, service quality, cost drivers, and customer impact, using these insights to shape strategic and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key areas of focus:

Service Partner Development

  • Lead global Operations tender activity across key warehousing 3PL, control tower 4PL, transportation, and logistics service partners.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and regional Operations teams to ensure tender processes are commercially robust and operationally aligned.
  • Support service partner strategy, performance management, governance, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide budgetary oversight and centralised analysis of OPEX and CAPEX spend across Operations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve partner performance, cost efficiency, service delivery, and operational scalability.

Lean Transformation: Operations Lean Kaizen Office

  • Lead the Operations Lean Kaizen Office as the centre of excellence for Lean transformation across SIE Operations.
  • Drive Lean continuous improvement activities across all operational areas.
  • Support weekly and monthly S&OE practices, ensuring continuous improvement is embedded into operational routines and decision-making.
  • Lead and support Kaizen events, value stream mapping, Gemba walks, process diagnostics, and waste reduction initiatives.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, service quality, process flow, and operational performance.
  • Build Lean capability across teams through coaching, standards, tools, and practical application.

Distribution Excellence

  • Oversee global operational standardisation across distribution, warehousing, transportation, and fulfilment practices.
  • Ensure SIE delivers one consistent, high level of operational service excellence to its global customer base.
  • Develop data-driven insights into how operational practices impact customers, commercial outcomes, cost, and service performance.
  • Act as the central funnel point for commercial and customer requests, translating business needs into operational realities.
  • Identify global best practices and scale them across regions, partners, and operational functions.
  • Establish performance metrics, governance forums, and improvement roadmaps to drive accountability and progress.

What we’re looking for:

  • 15+ years’ experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Operational Excellence, Lean Transformation, or a related global leadership role.
  • Proven experience leading Operational Excellence, Lean, continuous improvement, or business transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of global supply chain operations, including warehousing, transportation, distribution, 3PL/4PL management, and operational governance.
  • Experience leading or supporting global tenders, service partner development, and supplier performance improvement.
  • Strong financial acumen, with experience overseeing or analyzing OPEX, CAPEX, cost performance, and budgetary controls.
  • Demonstrated experience with Lean tools and methodologies, including Kaizen, value stream mapping, Gemba, standard work, waste reduction, and continuous improvement routines.
  • Strong ability to translate commercial and customer requirements into operational plans and scalable processes.
  • Excellent leadership skills, with experience managing high-performing teams of specialists or transformation experts.
  • Strong analytical capability, with the ability to turn operational data into strategic insight and measurable improvement.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills across Operations, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, Customer Service, and regional leadership teams.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.

description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the Programme This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems. You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth. High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve. What You’ll Do Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders. Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping. Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com ’s solutions with their goals. Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution. Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter. Who We’re Looking For We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success: Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals. Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output. Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders. Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success. Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter. Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance. What You’ll Get Out of It A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars: Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives. AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting. Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles. Want to Stand Out? When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Who should apply? raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Programme

This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems.

You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth.

High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve.

What You’ll Do

  • Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

  • Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

  • Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

  • Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com’s solutions with their goals.

  • Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

  • Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

  • Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

  • Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

  • Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

  • Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

  • Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

  • Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance.

What You’ll Get Out of It

A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars:

  • Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives.

  • AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting.

  • Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing

  • Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles.

Want to Stand Out?

When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  • Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive.

  • When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027.

  • What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications.

  • Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai.

  • Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

title: Director - Power Systems and Grid Transformation
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation

Location: Amsterdam ( preferred), or London
Reports to: Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead
Role type: Full-time

Role Overview

Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.

This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.

This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.

This is a senior leadership role combining:

  • Deep power systems expertise
  • Top-tier strategy problem solving
  • Origination and senior client leadership
  • Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes
  • Team leadership and platform-building

You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.

Key Responsibilities

Power Systems & Grid Transformation

  • Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.
  • Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.
  • Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.
  • Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.

Strategic Advisory

  • Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.
  • Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.
  • Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.

Systems Change & Platform Leadership

  • Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.
  • Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.
  • Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.
  • Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.

Origination & Growth

  • Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor high-performing teams.
  • Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

  • Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory
  • Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.

Core Capabilities

  • Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.

Desirable Experience

description:

More about the role:

You will be the counsel clients turn to when reputation is on the line, leading integrated teams to deliver outstanding work that protects, builds and advances their standing with the audiences that matter most.

We are looking for someone with deep corporate communications expertise and proven issues experience, who understands how reputation, policy and public sentiment intersect, and who can guide clients with confidence through a fast-moving and often complex landscape.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Sector knowledge in one or more of Energy, Healthcare or Technology, with an understanding of the reputational, regulatory and stakeholder issues that shape these industries.

#LI-RE1

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

About the role

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.
  • Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.
  • Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.
  • Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.
  • Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.
  • Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.
  • Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.
  • Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.
  • Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.
  • Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of:

  • HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.
  • HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.
  • JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.
  • Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.
  • Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.
  • txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.
  • Structured data and Schema.org.
  • Core Web Vitals and web performance.
  • International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.
  • Website and platform migrations.
  • Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

  • Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.
  • Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.
  • Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.
  • Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.
  • Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.
  • Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.
  • Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.

Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.

What you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.
  • Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.
  • Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.
  • Strong experience working with large and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.
  • Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.
  • A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.
  • An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.
  • Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.

What we offer: 

We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. 
 
Our compensation: 

  • A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.
  • Hybrid working flexibility.
  • Access to learning platforms .
  • Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. 
  • Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. 
  • Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. 
  • At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth. 

 

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
